page.notes: Page is a printed index, two columns, with no page number. The bottom INDEX is treated as the running head. The Hebrew word beside "Hebrçis quid significet" is hard to read; the letters given are uncertain and marked [?]. The printed "uoluptates", "uotum", "uulgus" and similar forms are kept as printed. Original printed values such as "conferuatus" and "Haerem." are copied as seen; some letters in the scan are faint and may be misread, especially in the 140–146 references.
